items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Mike Bess, he was the other partner.

ctx.x: You didn't know that they were gangsters.

No, sir. Owney Madden I think I saw once or twice. Mike Bess, he was the other partner. Herman Starks -- so I didn't know. Back to Joe Jones -- my wife and I were sitting listening to the group that was playing there, and Joe finished his solo.
This is at the West End Bar?
